The present contempt case has been filed for initiating contempt proceeding against the opposite party no.2 for his wilful and deliberate violation of the order dated 1st March, 2021 passed by this Court in W.P.(C) No.210 of 2021.

sentences.text:
The contempt case was earlier taken up on 21st July, 2023 and on the said following order was passed:-
"Reference may be made to the order dated 26.11.2021 which reads as under:
"The contempt case is taken up today through Video conferencing.

A show cause affidavit has been filed on behalf of the opposite party no. 2 stating inter alia that in pursuance of representation dated 22.03.2021 filed by the petitioners in terms with order dated 01.03.2021 passed by this Court in W.P.(C) No.
210 of 2021, the matter was enquired in presence of the petitioners by issuing memo no. 466/L.A. dated 01.04.2021 to the Project Director, NHAI, PIU, Durgapur (W.B.)
requesting him to furnish a report regarding acquisition and utilization of actual land of the petitioners as the petitioners were claiming compensation for 5 decimals of land, whereas they were paid compensation for only 1 decimal of land as per notification dated 27.11.2013 issued under Section 3D(1) of the National Highways Act, 1956.

Reminders have also been issued to the Project Director, NHAI, PIU,
Durgapur (W.B.) requesting inter alia to send the said report, however, the same has not yet been received from the Project Director due to which the claim of the petitioners towards redressal of their grievance could not be taken up under the provisions of the Act, 1956.

Mr. M.M. Sharma, learned counsel for the petitioners, submits that under the said circumstance, the Project Director, NHAI, PIU, Durgapur (W.B.) may be allowed to be impleaded as opposite party no. 3 in the present contempt petitioner.
He accordingly prays for two weeks' time to file interlocutory application for the said purpose.
In view of the said prayer, put up this case under appropriate heading after two weeks.''

Subsequently, the case was taken up on 25.02.2022 and on the said date,
learned counsel for the O.P.No.3 [the Project Director, National Highway Authority of India, NH-02, PIU Durgapur, Burdwan (West Bengal)] was directed to file the show cause affidavit within four weeks.

sentences.text: However, no show cause affidavit has yet been filed on behalf of the said O.P.
Hence, the O.P.No.3 is directed to file show cause/compliance affidavit within two weeks positively, failing which he shall remain physically present before this Court on the next date fixed.

Put up this case on 11.08.2023 under the heading ''For Admission''.
3.

Thereafter, it was listed on 11th August, 2023 and on the said date, the Court passed the following order:-
"A show cause affidavit dated 09.08.2023 has been filed on behalf of the opposite party no. 3, paragraph no. 8 of which reads as under:

sentences.text:
That it is humbly stated and submitted by the answering opposite party that on joint verification, the land appertaining to Khata No. 18, Plot Nos. 735, 736,
measuring an area of 1 decimal and 4.49 decimals respectively of Mouza- Saharjori are as per and in accordance with the proposed acquisition.
A copy of the joint measurement report has been annexed as Annexure-A to the said show cause affidavit.

Mr. Munna Lal Yadav, SC (L&C)-III appearing on behalf of the opposite party no. 2, prays for four weeks' time to make effective payment of compensation to the petitioners with respect to Plot No.
736 measuring an area of 4.49 decimals and any further compensation, if admissible to the petitioners in lieu of acquisition of the land in question.
The opposite party no. 2 shall file compliance affidavit before the next date fixed.

Put up this case under the heading "For Admission" on 15.09.2023."
4.
A supplementary show cause affidavit has been filed on behalf of the opposite party no.2 on 12th September, 2023, paragraph nos.5 and 6 of which read as under:-

"5. That, a joint measurement was held on 03.12.2021 in presence of the Representative of the NHAI, PIU, Durgapur and the petitioner and it was directed that 5.49 decimals of plot no.735 and 736 is falling within the road alignment and acquisition of 3.49 decimals of plot no.736 is necessary for payment to the petitioner and requisition of 3.49 decimals of plot no.736 is required from NHAI,
PIU, Durgapur for completion of necessary formalities towards acquisition of the said 3.49 decimals of plot no.736.
6.

That, NHAI, PIU, Durgapur has not submitted any requisition of 3.49 decimals of plot no.736 after joint measurement dated 03.12.2021 and request has been made from the Project Director,
National Highways Authority, Durgapur letter no.1023/LA dated 02.08.2023 and Letter No.1133/LA dated 06.09.2023 for submission of requisition against 3.49 decimals of plot no.736.
Due to non- submission of requisition by the NHAI, PIU, Durgapur further process of acquisition could not be finalized and at least 6 months time is required after receipt of requisition from the NHAI, PIU, Durgapur in compliance of the order of the Hon'ble Court."

5. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and considering the facts and circumstances of the case, the opposite party nos.2 and 3 are granted three months' time to make effective payment of compensation to the petitioners with respect to plot no.736, measuring an area of 3.49 decimals and any further compensation found admissible to the petitioners in lieu of acquisition of the land in question.
If the said payment is not made within the aforesaid period, the petitioners will be at liberty to file a fresh contempt case against the opposite parties.
6. The contempt proceeding as against the opposite parties is hereby dropped.
